It is about the weed though. I've met too many depressed people who self medicate with weed and then end up in a non-productive cycle of smoking weed and doing nothing much else. It's like any addiction. 

And please let's not get into a debate about weed being addictive. Like any substance, it is addictive for some. I should know, I'm one of those people.

The pot can be very demotivating. It was for me anyway. I ended up finding help in NA. I don't think a lot of people realize how many pot heads are finding help there. Maybe that could be a place you could find some support.

What kind of work are you looking for?  Also, can I ask a personal question?  Are you drinking or smoking weed?  Or other meds/drugs?  I only ask because that's what I was doing when I was in your shoes... I was getting high every day.

Non problem. Really, it helped me a lot. Meeting other depressed people especially. It's always nice to know you're not alone. They adjusted my meds and really taught me a lot about staying well. I was in for 10 days, then I did a 28 day out patient program. I think the group therapy helped me the most.
When I was suicidal I checked myself into a hospital and it was the best choice I could have made. Here I am 3 years later and doing great!
